# Surfaces

Ground surfaces (A11.5, `PRE-20`): each names the ladder its light picks from, the share of its ground with stones and their size, and the share with tufts, which the ground shader stamps where they span enough art pixels.
The picture's ground takes one surface per square metre from the area's material; numbers are decimal strings, shares from 0 to 1 and sizes in metres, from the mockup's choices in `terrainFS`.

## Grass

Open grass on gentle ground, tufts on about four cells in ten.

<!-- table: generated by `kd catalog tables`; edit the block, not the table -->
| | |
|---|---|
| Ladder | grass |
| Stones | share 0, about 0.08 m across |
| Tufts | share 0.38 |
<!-- end table -->

```toml
id = "grass"
name = "Grass"
stage = "MIL-01"
checks = ["PRE-20"]
ladder = "grass"
stone_density = "0"
stone_size = "0.08"
tuft_density = "0.38"
```
